msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 4:3, referencia lb-metales-y-gemas-09.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury campaign still life of yellow gold chains and pendants on black velvet necklace busts in a bright white showcase from the reference, arranged on pale travertine stone with soft late-afternoon sunlight and delicate shadows, the piece filling the centre-right of the frame, warm ivory tones, macro-sharp detail. One single continuous photograph. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia lb-metales-y-gemas-01.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of a yellow gold flat mariner link chain from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia lb-metales-y-gemas-06.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of a yellow gold ring with a large red stone in an ornate setting from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia lb-metales-y-gemas-07.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of a large gold crown pendant paved with white stones on a gold rope chain from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight.
